scenario.summary: Guest searches four products by SKU and adds each to the product compare list from the PLP.
steps: For each of 4 products: search its SKU, hover the product, click Compare, Add more
assertions: Compare link and Add more popup work (page-object checks)
evidence: First method captures: addProductsToCompareList is the head (verifyMaximumLimitReachedMessagePopup and navigateToProductComparePage depend on it; verifyProductDetails, verifySendEmailFunctionality and verifyBackLinkFunctionality depend on navigateToProductComparePage). It declares product1..product5 and compare; later methods read the class fields.
compare = STORE_WEBSTORE_PRODUCT_COMPARE_ENABLED {store} (Enable Product Comparison on; the 4-product limit is a webstore constant), as the Playwright plp compare entry.

product1..product4 = PRODUCT_SIMPLE_IN_STOCK {quantityUsed 1, store}, preferred the sheet SKUs productCompare!C5/D5/E5/F5 (z-2420001, z-2420004, z-2420005, z-2460001), not required; distinct aliases as the Playwright compare entry (simple/otherSimple). product5 (the fifth product verifyMaximumLimitReachedMessagePopup tries to add, productCompare!G5 z-2410001) is declared here too, its SKU declared from that method's source.

Not scanned (page object): verifyProductDetails reads each product's Brand, Price, Short/Long Description, Product Specification, Shipping Information and Min/Max Quantity from the productCompare sheet (rows 6-13). The migrated method compares productN.brandName, retailPrice, shortDescription, details (long description), specifications, shippingInfo, minQuantity and maxQuantity (outputs added to PRODUCT_SIMPLE_IN_STOCK 2026-11-10, user decision).
Readiness 2026-11-10: product3's sheet SKU z-2420005 does not qualify for PRODUCT_SIMPLE_IN_STOCK (the resolver falls back to another simple product); the other four qualify.
Sheet values: ProductName -> productN.name, ProductSKU -> productN.sku. No sign-in (guest).
Store: openWebstoreUrl opens automation_webStoreUrl (atstage: webstore-z10-atstage, the main store MaxwellsHardware), the same store as the Selenium pdp/quickOrder entries.
Profile: work/profiles/profile.json has no observations for these Selenium cells (profiled false); DB facts from bin/tda rows (2026-11-10) where cited.
Scanned constant values (locators, report messages, map key prefixes, regex) are framework constants: role config, no need.
migrate: Selenium reads Excel tables through TestData.getMap / getHashMap; there is no swap for Selenium.
